Definition: A period of economic or emotional downturn. There was a Great Depression in the US and several other countries.
To begin or start something. You commence the year with a new goal or resolution.
To cause someone to react or become angry. You provoke someone when you tease or bother them. Provokes, provoked, provoking.
To allow or endure something. I will tolerate only kind behavior. I will not tolerate bullying in this classroom. If you don’t follow our class rules, you will be testing my tolerance.
Really, really scared. If I saw a vampire bat, I would be terrified. The bat would terrify me. Terrify, terrifies, terrified, terrifying.
Getting back at someone because he or she did something bad to you. If your sister was mean to you and you played a trick on her, you would be getting revenge. Revenge is an antonym for forgiveness.
A phrase that means jumping on trains and riding in empty cars. People sometimes run along the side when a train is going slowly and then jump on.
A place where hobos go to hide out when they get off trains. It’s called a cardboard jungle because many hobos use cardboard boxes as homes.
